title: Detect a Cycle (Undirected Graph)
summary: Decide whether an undirected graph contains a cycle. A breadth-first search remembers each vertex's parent; meeting a seen vertex that is not the parent proves a second route exists.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Edges
inputs.hint: Edges as pairs of vertex numbers, for example 0, 1, 1, 2 means the edges 0–1 and 1–2. Vertex numbers start at 0.

inputs.name: vertices
inputs.label: Number of vertices
inputs.hint: From 1 to 8. Vertices are numbered 0 up to one less than this number.
